name: Raid Haven
summary:
Raid Haven is a strategy, wave-based survival game focused on building fortified bases and defending against ever-more-powerful raids. Gear up your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, adapt your defences, and survive wave after wave of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Build walls, traps, killboxes and defences to create an impenetrable fortress.

Face different raider archetypes every wave, each with their own strengths and tactics. Adapt your defences and strategy to survive whatever comes next.

Choose powerful rewards, equip your pawns, upgrade your gear, hire mercenaries, and adapt your defences before the next wave.

Inspired by RimWorld's tactical pawn-based combat, Raid Haven takes that foundation and puts the focus entirely on building, defending and surviving increasingly dangerous raids. Raid Haven is an independently developed game, built from the ground up by a solo developer with a passion for strategy, base building and tactical combat.
